The connection closed or failed. Check the network, Bluetooth and pairing code.

For Bluetooth, pair both Android devices in system settings first. Classic Bluetooth messaging with iPhone is unsupported. For LAN, join the same Wi-Fi network or hotspot. Router client isolation can block connections.

Choose the same transport on both devices. On the receiving device, tap “Start waiting for connection”. On the other device, select the paired Bluetooth device or enter its LAN address, enter its pairing code and tap “Connect to peer”.

An ongoing notification lets you stop waiting or disconnect. The session can continue in the background or with the screen locked. Force stop, network loss, disabled Bluetooth or power restrictions can interrupt it. An active session uses more battery. Offline delivery is unavailable.

Messages use a pairing code and AES-256-GCM. No cloud server is involved. The protocol has not been independently audited. The code stays on this device and can be refreshed while idle. The service keeps up to 100 messages in memory until it stops.
